title: UthreatPresence

uthreatId.description: The unique ID of the uthreat from the system.

muted.description: `true` if uthreat has been muted using uthreatMute. `suppressed` is used with RF threats that have been removed by SiteFilter. `type` is used with RF threats that have been muted using threatTypeMute. Threats with muted state `suppressed` or `type` are not sent by default on API. They can be enabled using uthreatSubscribe.

affiliation.description: Affiliation of threat. Also known as basic standard identity in MIL-STD-2525C. Extended with falseDetection.

associatedUthreatId.description: Used to link controller and drone.

description.description: Information about the threat. E.g. the manufacturer of the drone causing the threat.

lat.description: Latitude of the origo of the presence detection of the threat (geographical coordinate).

lon.description: Longitude of the origo of the presence detection of the threat (geographical coordinate).

x.description: East/west relative to mission center of the origo of the presence detection of the threat (cartesian coordinate) [m].

y.description: North/south relative to mission center of the origo of the presence detection of the threat  (cartesian coordinate) [m].

z.description: Height above/under mission center of the origo of the presence detection of the threat  (cartesian coordinate) [m].

rfInfo.description: Collection of RF information of the threat

frequencyBands.description: The current frequency bands of the threat.

possibleBands.description: The possible frequency bands of the threat. This may contain more frequencies than 'frequencyBands' for threats, that are known to use multiple frequency bands.

uthreatBasis.description: Collection of threat detections related to this uthreat

createdTimeStamp.description: UTC time of creation of this uthreat.

updatedTimeStamp.description: UTC time of the last update of this uthreat. For a new threat this will be equal to createdTimeStamp. Stopping a uthreat counts as an update, and will update this time stamp. UthreatBasis time stamps are not updated when stopped.

stoppedTimeStamp.description: UTC time of stop of this uthreat. Only set when threat is stopped. Also see updatedTimeStamp.
